# Lysa

> Lysa is an AI real estate employee that works on WhatsApp. It qualifies leads, recommends properties, books showings, and answers brokerage questions 24/7 so agents can focus on closings.

Lysa is a deployable product for real estate brokerages and independent agents, not a DIY chatbot builder. Primary channel today is WhatsApp; it can also be extended to Instagram, Facebook Messenger, SMS, and email on request.

## Site

- Home: https://textlysa.com
- Blog: https://textlysa.com/blog
- Book a demo: https://calendly.com/jojoamankwa/j
- Product app: https://app.textlysa.com

## Product capabilities

- Lead Qualification Tools: detect buyer or seller intent and hand structured Hot/Warm/Cold leads to the team
- Property Discovery: match buyer requirements to listings with recommendations in real time
- Showing Booking: offer slots, confirm appointments, and notify agents
- Knowledge Agent: answer brokerage FAQs and property questions from your documents
- Property Valuation Agent: comps and market data for faster valuations
- Document Processing Agent: extract key terms from agreements and disclosures
- Market Analysis Agent: price trends, days on market, inventory, neighborhood comparisons
- Tenant Communication Agent: maintenance, lease questions, payment reminders
- Maintenance Prediction Agent: predict service needs before breakdowns

## Pricing

- Deployment: $449 one-time (setup, WhatsApp integration, knowledge upload, testing, go-live)
- Lysa: $79/month (hosted infrastructure, AI usage, maintenance, monitoring, updates, priority support)
- Typical deployment time: about 7 days
- Billing: month-to-month after deployment

## Audience

- Real estate brokerages
- Independent agents

## Optional integrations

- CRM add-ons: GoHighLevel, HubSpot
- Base product includes exportable structured lead data
